findings.text: The fragment's <meta name="evidence-verdict" content="pass"> contradicts its own recorded measure: the body states per-call time is 0.42 of base (line 82), and profile-head.log records section_attempts_by_plan at 1.824 s against profile-base.log's 6.347 s (0.287 of base), while the section's done-when passes only when head per-call time is at most one fifth (0.2) of base.

negative_control_log names negative-control-version.log, whose mutation drops the version from the index file name, while the negative control this node declared was pointing the aggregate back at ledger.load; that run is negative-control.log, cited only in the note on line 14.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Verified four production call sites reaching the change: the roadmap builder, the section-count fallback, the section-attempt view enrichment, and the dispatch picker.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit from 3df04d103 to eba634efa: the source change is 49 lines in reckon/ledger.py and 4 in reckon/mcp_views.py, plus a 219-line test module and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: Section 45 lists three test cases plus base/head gate arms and a one-fifth per-call time bound; tests/test_section_attempts_read_the_projection.py holds the three cases and gate-base.log/gate-head.log record the arms, but the logged profile measure records 0.287 to 0.42 of base, above the stated one-fifth bound.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to read section attempts from the ledger index projection instead of full payloads; reckon/mcp_views.py:1644 now takes history rows from ledger.picker_runs and the widened projection carries the grouping's six fields, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records the four commits, both gate arms, the fair-pair and profile logs, and marks status complete, while the evidence fragment's meta declares a pass the recorded measure does not reach.
item_verdicts.write_paths: All four diff paths (reckon/ledger.py, reckon/mcp_views.py, tests/test_section_attempts_read_the_projection.py and the evidence fragment) are inside the node's declared write paths.
